findings.evidence: 505 rows processed; using items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 for reverse scoring matches the pipeline's rses_total output exactly for all 505 respondents (whereas following the guide with items 3, 5, 8, 9, and 10 results in 452 mismatches).
findings.description: The pipeline reverse-scores items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 instead of the correct University of Maryland / scoring guide items 3, 5, 8, 9, and 10 on the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES).
